name: has_style
title: Check if a string has some ANSI styling

origin.description: Whether each string contains an ANSI escape sequence.
origin.details: The test is a CSI or C1 sequence of the form crayon emits. A plain string is FALSE. red() is TRUE only when color is enabled, because otherwise red() does not insert codes.

translation.description: Whether each string contains an ANSI escape sequence.

arguments.name: string
arguments.text: A string or a list of strings.

translation.details: A str is one element. The pattern matches ESC [ ... m and the C1 CSI byte.
translation.value: A bool, or a list of bools.
translation.example: print("TRUE" if has_style("foobar") else "FALSE", "TRUE" if has_style(red("foobar")) else "FALSE")
